beginner.summary: For web and React developers and new mobile developers who have not shipped a React Native app before. Covers Expo SDK 58 and the React Native Community CLI on React Native 0.88, core components, Flexbox styling, TypeScript, FlatList, Expo Router navigation, state and hooks, forms, React Native DevTools, fetching data, AsyncStorage and expo-sqlite, images and fonts, camera, location and notifications through Expo modules, development builds, Expo Build (formerly EAS Build) and publishing to Google Play and the App Store.
prerequisites: Writes modern JavaScript with modules, arrow functions, promises and async/await
Has built a small React web app with components, props and state
Has a computer with Node.js 22 or later and Android Studio, plus a Mac with Xcode or an Expo account for iOS builds
outcomes: Create, run and debug React Native apps with Expo and the Community CLI on Android and iOS
Build typed screens with core components, Flexbox, FlatList, forms and Expo Router navigation
Store data with AsyncStorage and expo-sqlite and use the camera, location and notifications
Produce signed builds with Expo Build and release them to Google Play internal testing and TestFlight
